-- What a client importing `Spec.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.RestartNode` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def RestartNode.unifiedSpec : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (c : Loc) (cv : Config) (lok si : GoInterfaceOk) (σ : StorState)
    (hs : HardStateM) (csm : ConfStateM),
    ConfigValid cv →
      cv.Logger' = GoInterface.ok lok →
        cv.Storage' = GoInterface.ok si →
          sint.Z cv.MaxInflightMsgs' < 2 ^ 62 →
            cv.DisableProposalForwarding' = false →
              cv.ReadOnlyOption' = W64 0 →
                cv.DisableConfChangeValidation' = false →
                  cv.MaxCommittedSizePerReady' ≠ W64 0 ∨ cv.MaxSizePerMsg' ≠ W64 0 →
                    cv.AsyncStorageWrites' = false →
                      cv.Applied' = W64 0 →
                        σ.prev = { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 } →
                          σ.ents = [] →
                            uint.Z σ.ss.index' = 0 ∨ σ.ss = σ.prev →
                              σ.pend = [] →
                                HsEmpty hs →
                                  csm.Voters' = vs →
                                    csm.VotersOutgoing' = [] →
                                      csm.Learners' = [] →
                                        csm.LearnersNext' = [] →
                                          csm.AutoLeave' = false →
                                            σ.fl = W64 0 →
                                              ⊢
                                                ∀ Φ,
                                                  isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                                                      typedPointsto c cv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                                        isLogger lok ∗
                                                          isStorage (GoInterface.ok si) ∗
                                                            ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si) σ ∗
                                                              (□
                                                                  ∀ Φ ss',
                                                                    ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si)
                                                                        { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := ss',
                                                                          pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                                                                          sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl } -∗
                                                                      (∀ hp cs al,
                                                                          ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si)
                                                                              { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := ss',
                                                                                pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs,
                                                                                sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat,
                                                                                fl := σ.fl } -∗
                                                                            hsOpt hp hs -∗
                                                                              csPts cs DFrac.discard csm al -∗
                                                                                Φ
                                                                                  ((intoVal hp, intoVal cs),
                                                                                    intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                                                                        WP
                                                                          ((intoVal
                                                                              (methods si.ty
                                                                                go!"InitialState"
                                                                                si.v))
                                                                            (intoVal ()))
                                                                          {{ Φ }}) ∗
                                                                (nodeFounder γ N vs cv.ID' ∨
                                                                    nodeJoin γ N cv.ID' ∗
                                                                      confAt γ 0 (Membership.simple (listToSet vs)) ∗
                                                                        ⌜vs.Nodup⌝) ∗
                                                                  storageCertLink γ N (GoInterface.ok si) -∗
                                                    (▷
                                                        ∀ nd,
                                                          (∃ n,
                                                              ⌜nd = interface.mkOk node.ty.PointerType (intoVal n)⌝ ∗
                                                                isNode n γ N cv.ID' ∗
                                                                  nodeDriver n γ N
                                                                      (NodeDriverState.init (GoInterface.ok si)) ∗
                                                                    nodeConfig n γ N
                                                                      { applied := 0,
                                                                        membership :=
                                                                          Membership.simple (listToSet vs) }) -∗
                                                            Φ (intoVal nd)) -∗
                                                      WP ((intoVal (functions RestartNode [])) (intoVal c)) {{ Φ }}
